title: PCB is brought to you by Fable 5
summary: A personal blog post demonstrating the use of Fable 5, an AI-assisted or generative design tool, for creating custom PCBs (Printed Circuit Boards), showcasing practical hardware design workflow.
problem_solved: Simplifies and automates the PCB design process using AI-powered generation tools
why_valuable: Demonstrates how modern AI tools can accelerate hardware prototyping and make PCB design more accessible to developers
